_comment: Character Journal titles (journal.js; design ~/claude-nate-release/specs/character-journal-design.md section 4, Nate 2026-09-30: 'go with your recommendations', a player may choose among the titles they qualify for). A title is '<rank> <class>'. The rank comes from the average level of the skills that earned the class: ranks lists [floor, word]; fighting classes say fightingAdept instead of Adept. A class matches on the character's top three skills (level > 0, highest first): 'all' skills must be among them at 25+, plus one of 'any' when given; 'atLeast' of 'of'; 'top' must be the highest skill, at 25+; bySchool names a mage by their primary school (schools.js); 'professions' names the highest skill when it leads the next by 'lead' levels. Rename freely: ids are what players' choices are saved under.
_fallbacks: No class matched: 'Wanderer' when no skill reaches minLevel, else '<rank> Adventurer' from the highest skill.
